items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I don't think it was built by the Clark family at all. It was operated by Mr. Clark.

ctx.x: Then that was -- was it built by the Clark family or just operated by the Clark family?

I don't think it was built by the Clark family at all. It was operated by Mr. Clark. He also built an annex a couple years later, around 1932. He built an annex a half-block from there on the other side of the street, called The Clark Annex.
So there was a ballroom next door to the Clark and then what did -- and the Dunbar -- at what point did the Apex Club ... ? Downstairs in the Dunbar there was a lounge, wasn't there? (inaudible)?
